name: Vendor requirements matrix and classification guide
prompt: Write the vendor disclosure matrix at {target} from the vault's classification guide and the vendor's requirement list in {root}/requirements.md. Read the vault first. Use the Laurelin letterhead template from the vault, no other.
claim: The matrix is written from the vault guide, on the Laurelin letterhead, in the vendor's folder.
rubric: Each requirement row cites the vault classification guide.
Every value in the matrix matches the vault.
The document uses the Laurelin letterhead, not another company's.
The file sits in the vendor's folder.
source: Organizations/<vendor>/... Disclosure Matrix.md; Classification/Laurelin Classification Guide.md
note: Real job from PLAN.md section 15. Needs the vault as --root and Joe's review. Inputs named in the prompt ({root}/...) are staged by hand before the run.
